# Character enrichment sources

These optional, unreviewed annotations were supplied in the character-enrichment
handoff. The original canonical catalogue remains separate and unchanged.

- Make Me a Hanzi dictionary, commit bddc96d41bef78427ed0e034e9f7e31d71fd1b92:
  LGPL-3.0-or-later. Corresponding dictionary source and licence notices are in
  `notices/`. Source: https://github.com/skishore/makemeahanzi/tree/bddc96d41bef78427ed0e034e9f7e31d71fd1b92
- Hanzi Writer Data 2.0.1: Arphic Public License. Geometry is fetched on demand
  from the version-pinned package, not replaced by standalone components.
  Notice: `notices/STROKE_DATA_ARPHICPL.txt`.
- BabelStone IDS, 2025-06-27 / Unicode 16.0: source comparisons retain their
  regional qualifiers. The supplied manifest records permission evidence, not
  an independently established licence for all underlying characters. No full
  BabelStone snapshot is redistributed here. Source: https://www.babelstone.co.uk/CJK/IDS.TXT
- GF 0014-2009: eight bounded textual rule-example annotations only. No PDF,
  font artwork, table artwork or complete standard component inventory is
  redistributed. Source: https://www.unicode.org/irg/docs/n2739-GF0014-2009.pdf

`manifest.json` retains the supplied source versions, hashes, consumer policy,
licence-notice references and coverage. Original generator/audit utilities and
all their inputs were not provided; the local split adapter is not a substitute
for rerunning that upstream audit. Exact source agreement and complete stroke
coverage do not establish editorial approval, etymology or verified stroke names.

entries.text: 暴# expose + 火 fire → *explosion* that exposes objects → *bomb*.
灼也。从火暴聲。
燒也。从火蓺聲。《春秋傳》曰：“爇僖負覉。”
As per 樂# (grind/continue at length) + 火 fire → *shine*/*sparkle* continuously. *Melt* is a borrowed meaning, via 鑠.
灼爍，光也。从火樂聲。
As per 盧# (cooking pot) + 火 fire → *cooking stove*; *furnace* (compare 鑪) → *hearth*; *sunken fireplace*.
炙也。从炙尞聲。讀若𤒅燎。
火門也。从火閻聲。
盛也。从火曅聲。《詩》曰：“爗爗震電。”
火飛也。从火龠聲。一曰爇也。

闌# link + 火 fire → *bright* chain of flames (compare the Old Chinese cognate 粦 and its replacement character 燐). The character was however reinterpreted as flames attendant to boiling (compare 燗) or cooking → *spoil*; *rot* (← overcook food to the point of spoiling it) → *running sore*; *inflammation*.
As per 爵# (small) + 火 fire → small *torch*. Later, the meaning extended to include *bonfire*.
苣火，祓也。从火爵聲。呂不韋曰：湯得伊尹，爝以爟火，釁以犧豭。
旱气也。从火蟲聲。
取火於日官名，舉火曰爟。《周禮》曰：“司爟，掌行火之政令。”从火雚聲。
孰也。从火蘭聲。
齊謂之炊爨。𦥑象持甑，冂爲竈口，廾推林内火。凡爨之屬皆从爨。

A depiction of fingers curled about an object such as fruit in picking, plucking or pinching it. Although 爪 originally referred to picking up/at with the fingers, it eventually came to refer to the *nails* → *claw*; *scratch (at)*.
丮也。覆手曰爪。象形。凡爪之屬皆从爪。
As per 巴# (spread) + 爪 claw/hand → *crawl*/*creep*/*climb* over a surface. Also, via reinterpretation of the elements of this character, *scratch*.

The relevant seal inscription form is 爪 claw/hand + an element# combining a horizontal line symbolizing an object with 又 hand/action indicator → two parties tugging on a long, thin object → *struggle*; *compete*; *argue*; *fight*.
引也。从𠬪、𠂆。
并舉也。从爪，冓省。

A horizontal line + an element# that is 爪 claw/hand + an element combining an object and 又 hand/action indicator → twist an object about a stick → *lead to* (← twist and come to an end) → *then*; *thus* (← primary and secondary effects of an action).
引也。从𠬪从于。籒文以爲車轅字。

The relevant oracle bone form of this character is 爫/爪 hand/claw + 象 elephant → brandish a curved stick in training elephants, transforming their behavior. *Do* is an associated meaning (← use the hands and accomplish an objective) → *make*; *arrange*. Also, *become* and *change into* (compare 化), as well as *on behalf of* and *because of* (← do/perform for the benefit of another). The pronunciation of 爲 suggests that 象 has replaced another element, one likely indicating a different animal.
母猴也。其爲禽好爪。爪，母猴象也。下腹爲母猴形。王育曰：“爪，象形也。”

A depiction of a small bronze container in the shape of a sparrow, presented as a reward for services rendered to the state, and used for warming alcohol. The meaning later shifted to indicate a goblet, specifically, one in a set of goblets. *Peerage* and *court ranking* are associated meanings, via the social strata of the recipients.
禮器也。象爵之形，中有鬯酒，又持之也。所以飲。器象爵者，取其鳴節節足足也。
The relevant oracle bone form of this character depicts a hand spread over the handle of an ax (compare 兵). *Father* is a borrowed meaning.
矩也。家長率教者。从又舉杖。
父 father + 巴# for the sound alone to simulate a term of address directed toward a *father*. Compare the conjunction between the sound "pa" and the meaning "father" in many Indo-European languages.
Originally, 父 father + 多# for the sound alone to transliterate an Altaic language term meaning *father* → *grandfather*; *old man*. Later, 多 was replaced by 耶#.
Curving, crossing lines (divined to obtain knowledge of the future) → *cross*; *mix*. Compare 交.
交也。象《易》六爻頭交也。凡爻之屬皆从爻。

The relevant oracle bone form of this character is 大 stand outstretched + an X on both sides of the chest# → clear the heart and body of impurities → *clear*; *refreshing* (compare 清 and 淨). Later, each of the X marks was replaced by 井 well, with the present form in turn replacing the 井 elements with 爻.
明也。从㸚从大。

A depiction of a large seal (for pressing images that adhere in soft clay or, later, on documents). *That*, *so*, *you*, *just*, *near* and *like* are borrowed meanings. In dual-element characters, 爾 sometimes appears in the reduced form 尓.
麗爾，猶靡麗也。从冂从㸚，其孔㸚，尒聲。此與爽同意。
A depiction of a long and slender, wooden sleeping pallet → *long, wooden sleeping pallet* (compare 片) → *piece of wood*.

爿# long, wooden sleeping pallet + 木 tree/wood → (long and thin) wooden *bed* → wooden *stand*, *chair* or *couch*. Also, *wood floor*. Compare 床. Logically, the classifier for 牀 should be 木, but it is traditionally given as 爿.
安身之坐者。从木爿聲。
牡羊也。从羊爿聲。
鳥獸來食聲也。从倉爿聲。《虞書》曰：“鳥獸牄牄。”
As per 嗇# (granary) + 爿 long, wooden sleeping pallet (→ long, wooden object) → long wooden *fence* extending around a granary → *hedge*; *wall*.
垣蔽也。从嗇爿聲。
Reverse image of 爿 long, wooden sleeping pallet, both of which show a long piece of wood split down the middle → *thin and flat piece*; *part* → *few*; *little*; *one* (of a pair/set); *one side*.
判木也。从半木。凡片之屬皆从片。

As per 反# (thin sheet) + 片 (long piece of wood split down the middle) → *wooden slat*. Virtually the same as 板, except that 版 came to refer to woodblocks used in the printing process → (printing) *block*; *printing* → *edition*.
判也。从片反聲。
As per 卑# (spread low) + 片 (thin and flat piece of wood) → low-lying *signboard* → *tablet*; (playing) *cards*.
築牆短版也。从片俞聲。讀若俞。一曰若紐。
牀版也。从片扁聲。讀若邊。

As per 枼# as described in 葉 (thin/flat/slight) + 片 (long piece of wood split down the middle) → thin wooden slats containing records → *papers*; (official) *document* (← wood as a writing medium; compare 帖).
札也。从片枼聲。
As per 旁# (spread to/be on both sides) + 片 thin and flat piece → *tablet* serving as a *public notice*, inscribed on both sides.
穿壁以木爲交窻也。从片、戶、甫。譚長以爲：甫上日也，非戶也。牖，所以見日。

As per 𧶠# as described in 續 (pass along) + 片 (long piece of wood split down the middle) → written instruments for passing along knowledge → *inscribed tablet*; *writings*; *letter*. For the transmission of knowledge, compare 讀.
書版也。从片賣聲。
A depiction of fangs or tusks that mesh with or cross over the bottom teeth (compare 齬 and 顎) → *fang*; *tusk*. Also, *tooth/teeth*.
牡齒也。象上下相錯之形。凡牙之屬皆从牙。
As per 尚# (rise → raise) + 牙 fangs/mesh → *support post* (← pieces of meshed wood that rise to meet and support a ceiling; compare 楨) → *a prop/support*.
A depiction of a *cow*. The pronunciation of the character simulates lowing.
大牲也。牛，件也；件，事理也。象角頭三、封㞑之形。凡牛之屬皆从牛。
As per 匕# (double-pronged and aligned) + 牛 cow → the genitals of a cow (dual ovarian-tubed organ of a double-pronged appearance) → *female* genitals.
畜母也。从牛匕聲。《易》曰：“畜牝牛，吉。”
牛# cow (→ mooing/lowing of a cow) + 厶 (plow) → *moo*; *low* (v.) (← sounds produced by a bovine dragging a plow). Also, *seek* (← call out for something).
牛鳴也。从牛，象其聲气从口出。
As per 士 (erect; male) + 牛# cow/bull → (erect) bull → *male* (creatures).
畜父也。从牛土聲。
宀 roof/building + 牛# cow → barn/stable for cattle → *jail/prison* → *secure* → *hard*; *tight* (← hard/tight security). Also, *sacrifice* (← sacrifice an animal confined for this purpose).
閑，養牛馬圈也。从牛，冬省。取其四周帀也。
As per 刃# (cut with a) blade + 牛 cow → *fill* a vessel with the blood of a sacrificed cow (compare 血) → *be full*.
牣，滿也。从牛刃聲。《詩》曰：“於牣魚躍。”
As per 攵# (strike) + 牛 cow → strike cattle → *raise livestock*; *pasture*.
養牛人也。从攴从牛。《詩》曰：“牧人乃夢。”
As per 勿# (obscure) + 牛 cow → obscure (= unremarkable) cow → *thing(s)*; *object(s)* (← things/objects of unremarkable characteristics ).
萬物也。牛爲大物；天地之𢿙，起於牽牛，故从牛。勿聲。
四歲牛。从牛从四，四亦聲。
生# birth; life + 牛 cow → sacrificial cow offered for the renewal of life → *sacrifice*.
牛完全。从牛生聲。
As per 氐# (press) + 牛 cow → (two cows/bulls that) *butt* horns/heads; *touch*; *come into contact with*. Compare 羝 and 觝.
觸也。从牛氐聲。
As per 全# (fully) + 牛 cow → cow fully of one color → *cow with a hide of a single color* → *sacrificial cow*.
牛純色。从牛全聲。
As per 字# (produce numerous offspring) + 牛 cow → *female cow* (← producer of numerous offspring) → *female*.
As per 寺# (stand straight) + 牛 cow → particularly tall bull, surpassing others → *special*; *excellent*; *outstanding*. For the idea of being excellent in the sense of surpassing, compare 卓.
朴特，牛父也。从牛寺聲。
白黑雜毛牛。从牛尨聲。
牛厀下骨也。从牛巠聲。《春秋傳》曰：“宋司馬牼字牛。”

As per 玄# (link) + an element combining 牛 cow and 冖 cover (→ bar used to hold down the horns of cattle; compare 衡) → *drag/draw* a cow with a rope → *lead*. Also, *be involved in/with* (← be directly connected ← drag with a rope).
引前也。从牛，象引牛之縻也。玄聲。
As per 吾# (crossing) + 牛 cow → cattle crossing horns in butting heads (compare 麌) → *go against*; *be contrary/opposed to*.
牛馬牢也。从牛告聲。《周書》曰：“今惟牿牛馬。”
Originally, 尸# body + 辛 needle/cutting tool → slow, lumbering, horned animal → dual-horned species of *rhinoceros* (← horns in alignment). Later, the character came to be written as 牛 cow + 尾 tail.
南徼外牛。一角在鼻，一角在頂，似豕。从牛㞑聲。
犁 is as per 利# (plow) + 牛 cow → cattle-drawn *plow*. However, in contemporary Japanese usage, 犁has been supplanted by the form 犂.
特牛也。从牛岡聲。
Effectively a variant form of 奔 run, with the 牛 cow elements suggesting *jostle*; *throng*; *stampede* (originally, with respect to cattle).
黃牛黑脣也。从牛𦎫聲。《詩》曰：“九十其犉。”
建 here an abbreviated form# of 腱 tendon + 牛 cow → cut tendons in castrating bulls → *castrated bull*; *castration*.
犗牛也。从牛建聲。亦郡名。
高# high/tall + 牛 cow → kill and serve up a tall cow (to victorious soldiers) → *offer thanks*; *reward*.
以芻莖養牛也。从牛、芻，芻亦聲。《春秋國語》曰：“犓豢幾何。”
駁牛也。从牛，勞省聲。
騬牛也。从牛害聲。
三歲牛。从牛參聲。
An abbreviated form# of 釐 (plow long, neat furrows) + 牛 cow → *yak* (← bovine, used as a beast of burden).
西南夷長髦牛也。从牛𠩺聲。凡犛之屬皆从犛。
無角牛也。从牛童聲。古通用僮。
牛白𦟝也。从牛厲聲。
Abbreviated form# of 贖 expiation + 牛 cow → sacrificial *calf* → *sacrificial victim*.
牛子也。从牛，瀆省聲。
牛黃白色。从牛麃聲。
羲 is a variant form# of 義 (sacrifice in a ceremony). 犧 adds 牛 cow → *sacrifice* a cow.
宗廟之牲也。从牛羲聲。賈侍中說：此非古字。
牛息聲。从牛雔聲。一曰牛名。
A depiction of a *dog*. The pronunciation of the character simulates barking.
狗之有縣蹏者也。象形。孔子曰：“視犬之字如畫狗也。”凡犬之屬皆从犬。
犬 dog/beast + 丿# (split) → dog splitting away from the earth in leaping to snatch an object → *leap*; *open up/out*.
走犬皃。从犬而丿之。曳其足，則剌犮也。

The relevant seal inscription form of the right-hand element# is a frame. Here, the Old Chinese pronunciation suggest the particular sense " spread although encompassed by a framing object ." 犯 adds 犬 dog/beast → dog breaking out of its enclosure and running off → *violation* → *criminal (act)*.
侵也。从犬巳（段註改為㔾）聲。

As per 丬/爿# (long and slender) + 犬 dog/beast → long, slender dog/beast. *Situation* and *conditions* are borrowed meanings → *form*; *letter*; *describe*; *express* (← document reporting on conditions).
健犬也。从犬亢聲。
過弗取也。从犬巿聲。讀若孛。
犬形也。从犬爿聲。
As per 王# (extend) + 犬 dog/beast → dog that runs *wild* and extensively (compare 戻 and 猛) → *mad*; *crazy* → *manic*; *enthusiastic*. Also, *function improperly* (← fail to act normally).
狾犬也。从犬㞷聲。
As per 丑# (curve/bend) + 犬 dog/beast → dog curling up about its master → *become familiar/accustomed to* → *become proficient at*; *master* (← become accustomed to).
犬性驕也。从犬丑聲。
犭 here a variant of 豸# animal that ambles along the ground + 火 fire → disperse beasts with fire → *barbarian* (from the north) (← people known for using fire for this purpose ).
赤狄，本犬種。狄之爲言淫辟也。从犬，亦省聲。
犬視皃。从犬、目。
犬怒皃。从犬示聲。一曰犬難得。代郡有狋氏縣。讀又若銀。
As per 甲# (press down upon) + 犬 dog/beast → discipline an animal to *tame* it → *be accustomed to*; *be on intimate terms with* → *be overly familiar with*; *make light of*.
犬可習也。从犬甲聲。
As per 瓜# (solitary) + 犬 dog/beast → *fox* (that, atypically for Canidae, goes about in small family units rather than in packs).
䄏獸也。鬼所乘之。有三徳：其色中和，小前大後，死則丘首。从犬瓜聲。
As per 弗# (split) + 犬 dog/beast → hamadryad *baboon*, with brilliant symmetrical coloration on both sides of its muzzle.
As per 句# (bend) + 犬 dog/beast → bending figure of a *puppy* on unsteady legs (compare 駒) → *dog*.
孔子曰：“狗，叩也。叩气吠以守。”从犬句聲。
獸走皃。从犬戉聲。

As per 且# (pile) + 犬 dog/beast. The earliest meaning of 狙 was ape (← creature figuratively atop the simian pile; compare 姐), but the character came to mean *stalk*, (take) *aim at* and *watch for* (← ape of predatory habits; compare 猴).
玃屬。从犬且聲。一曰狙，犬也，暫齧人者。一曰犬不齧人也。
白# white + 犬 dog/beast → whitish, *wolf-like beast* → (pair of whitish, stone) *guardian lion-dogs* placed at shrine entrances.
如狼，善驅羊。从犬白聲。讀若蘗。甯嚴讀之若淺泊。
犬行也。从犬亘聲。《周禮》曰：“尚狟狟。”
As per 艮# (adhere) + 犬 dog/beast → *sounds produced by dogs (adhering in) fighting/biting each other* (compare 獄). *Perversion* is a borrowed meaning.
吠鬬聲。从犬艮聲。
As per 交# (twist/cross) + 犬 dog/beast → *cunning/crafty* animal (compare 獪 and 猾) able to twist and make its escape → *sly*; *deceitful*.
少狗也。从犬交聲。匃奴地有狡犬，巨口而黑身。
惡健犬也。从犬，𠛹省聲。
犬食也。从犬从舌。讀若比目魚鲽之鲽。

As per 守# (enclose/surround) + 犬 dog/beast → *hunt* by surrounding animals (or, by driving them into an enclosure and surrounding to prevent their escape) → *gather*; *pick* → *view nature* (← enjoy the outdoors).
犬田也。从犬守聲。《易》曰：“明夷于南狩。”
肙 as described in 絹, here an abbreviated form# of 悁 irritable + 犬 dog/beast → irritable dog/beast → *hasty*; *perverse* → *obstinate*.
褊急也。从犬肙聲。

貍 is 里 here an abbreviated form# of 埋 bury + 豸 animal that ambles along the ground → fox-like animal that shelters in burrows or dens. In Japan however 貍 has been applied to the *raccoon dog* → *sly* (← supposed attribute of a raccoon dog). 狸 replaces 豸 with 犬 dog/beast.
As per 夾# (pressed between) + 犬 dog/beast → be pressed on by wild animals, with nowhere to turn → *narrow* (← narrow margin for escape) → *small*; *reduce*; *narrow-minded*.
As per 夋# as described in 俊 (stand erect) + 犬 dog/beast → a mythical beast of obscure attributes. The compound 狻猊 refers to a lion.
狻麑，如虦貓，食虎豹者。从犬夋聲。見《爾雅》。
As per 良# (flowing stream) + 犬 dog/beast → *wolf* (← animal belonging to a large pack the hunting activities of which are likened to a flowing stream) .
似犬，銳頭，白頰，高前，廣後。从犬良聲。
狂犬也。从犬折聲。《春秋傳》曰：“狾犬入華臣氏之門。”
